    FROM (
      SELECT
        email,
        paid,
        (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY paid DESC, paid_at ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC, email ASC
        ))::int AS position
      FROM waitlist
    ) ranked
    WHERE email = ${email}
  `;

}
